commit.message:
Pin GitHub Actions to full-length commit SHAs (#120)

* Pin GitHub Actions to full-length commit SHAs

* Fix pre-commit poetry lock hook for Poetry 2.x

`poetry lock --check` was removed in Poetry 2.0. The CI installs the
latest Poetry via install.python-poetry.org, so the hook fails with
`The option "--check" does not exist`, breaking the required
`build-linux` check on every PR.

Replace it with the supported equivalent, `poetry check --lock`.
